summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of SURAKSHA AR platform. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed (health, config, users idempotency, attempts increment, certificates JH-SAFE issuance & verification, admin stats/workers/analytics/certificates). Frontend: full worker journey verified end-to-end on mobile viewport 390x844 — Language(EN/HI/Santali) → Register → Dashboard(all cards & links) → Fire Module → AR simulation (continue-sim, scanning 2.6s, start-simulation, 4 tasks: tap exit-correct, tap ext-correct, order 0..5, tap assembly1) → Assessment (7 fire questions answered correctly) → Result (100% pass, get-certificate-btn) → Certificate (certificate-card + JH-SAFE-2026-000141 + verify-cert-btn2 rendered with QR). Verify screen tested both invalid (Not Found) and valid (?cid= auto-verify shows VERIFIED). Admin dashboard loads with stats (20 workers, 71% pass, 17 certs), module performance bars, worker search (Rahul filter works), certificate search (JH-SAFE filter works). Demo screen scenario selection + demo-start-btn navigate to /ar/fire. Certificates screen renders. One notable UI bug: admin stat cards text wraps vertically per-character on desktop viewport (1280x800). No deprecated Expo packages detected. Console shows only minor RN 'shadow*' → 'boxShadow' deprecation warnings.

ui_bugs.issue: On desktop viewport (>=1000px), stat card values ('20') and labels ('Total Workers') wrap character-by-character vertically instead of on a single line. Card width is percentage but children lack flexShrink:0 / minWidth. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin.tsx:83-93, styles.statCard/statWide (line 205-208).

If accessed directly (no profile in storage) the effect returns early without setLoading(false), so screen sticks on 'Saving to server…' spinner forever. Add setLoading(false) in the guard. Reference: /app/frontend/app/certificate/[id].tsx:27-43.

issues: Stat card labels rendering one letter per line; consider single row layout with flex:1 min-widths and numberOfLines={1} on Text

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Multiple emissions during navigation. Non-blocking but should migrate shadow* to boxShadow in RN Web 0.19+.

action_items: Fix admin stat card layout on desktop: give stat cards a min-width and set label/value Text numberOfLines={1} or ensure card is not being squeezed by flex layout (statGrid flex row + wrap works on mobile but breaks values into per-char columns on wider viewport).
Certificate screen: when profile or module missing on direct load, set loading=false and show a friendly error/back button instead of infinite spinner.
Optional: replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow to silence RN Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py cleanly returns cleaned docs (excludes _id) — good.
admin_stats passRate uses total_att = 1 fallback which can inflate ratio if zero attempts; consider returning 0 when no attempts.
issueCertificate falls back to local ID silently on server error — reasonable offline behaviour.
seed_data_creation: Backend seed already populated 15 workers via prior POST /api/admin/seed. Test users prefixed with TEST_ created during pytest run (TestUsers/TestAttempts/TestCertificates). One extra worker created via UI (TEST Pass Worker) — bringing total to ~20.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fire assessment correct answers indices: [1,2,1,2,1,2,1]. AR flow: continue-sim-btn → wait 2.6s → start-simulation-btn → 4 tasks (ar-marker-exit-correct, ar-marker-ext-correct, ar-order-0..5 in order, ar-marker-assembly1), each needing ar-continue-btn after correct selection. Certificate page requires profile in AsyncStorage and LAST_RESULT_KEY; direct URL access without going through /result will loop on 'Saving to server…'. Admin desktop viewport has visible stat card layout bug.
rca_of_issue: Admin stat card char-wrapping RCA: styles.statWide sets width:'23.5%' of a 1100px maxWidth (~258px). The Card component likely applies flex:1 + alignItems:'stretch' with children in column layout, but the Text values inside get a width constrained by an inner flex item without minWidth, causing RN Web to lay out characters vertically. Fix: add minWidth or flex:0 and numberOfLines={1} on statValue/statLabel, or convert grid to CSS grid-like flex where each card is flexBasis based rather than percentage width.
